forecaster.label: minimum next-ten-session closing price / next-session opening price - 1 < -0.10
forecaster.purge: For a fit at close i, include only feature rows j <= i-10, with complete label and feature readiness. Every label therefore ends no later than the fit close. Fit within the active universe only; removed stocks are excluded from learning and signals.
forecaster.single_class: Laplace-smoothed empirical probability; no fictitious two-class fit

features: Only same-close/prior OHLCV: log returns 1/5/20/60/120, distances to EMA20/60/120, volatility20, downside semideviation20, drawdowns20/60, prior-volume-normalized activity, money flow20, distribution-day fraction10, active-universe positive-20-day-return breadth. No ticker, date, absolute price, forward statistic or full-sample normalization.
policy: Keep independent raw momentum ownership; initially enter after 3 healthy closes above EMA20 with EMA20>EMA60 and risk probability below threshold-0.10. Exit above the forecast threshold, or below EMA60*0.95 with negative 20-session momentum, or 20% trailing-60-session price drawdown while below EMA20. Recovery uses the same causal healthy confirmation. Fixed 20-session membership review; no symmetric volatility haircut or unrelated-universe veto.
selection_objective: mean(log(wealth / same_engine_buy_hold_wealth) - 0.75 * max_drawdown - 0.002 * max(0, orders_per_year - 20)); ties fewer fills then smaller candidate index
verification: Assert full-data predictions through 2025 exactly match a separately generated 2025-prefix forecast; preserve fit dates, maximum training-label dates, input/source/runtime identities, probabilities, all candidates and errors. 2026 rolling fits may use only labels already observed by each historical close.
interpretation: Retrospective development after six unsuccessful families. Walk-forward mechanics do not make previously inspected 2026 a pristine holdout. This is an exploratory forecasting experiment, not a production dependency or economic pass until supported by results.
